description: Four injection points: SessionStart routes once to the medium-matched skill (laws:code / laws:prompt / laws:prose) and resets the engaged-craft set on a fresh session; UserPromptSubmit re-engages the laws on every user message; PreToolUse on Skill guards craft compatibility, letting compatible crafts coexist but refusing a craft that is incompatible with one already engaged (today: laws:code with laws:prompt); PostToolUse on Write|Edit observes each written file's medium and, when its craft is not engaged, records the violation to the claude-laws state dir and nudges the agent once per medium - signal only, never a block.
